name: fantasy-gacha-dark
description: 日系二次元幻想手游暗色UI，适用于编队、背包、商店、设置等界面

interaction: Hover state brightens background by 10% and adds subtle glow ring
Active/pressed state darkens background by 15% and compresses shadow
Disabled state uses 40% opacity and desaturates color
Selected state shows a soft outer glow matching primary tint
typography: Chinese labels use medium weight, white or near-white color
Section titles use larger size (>=18px) with slight letter spacing
Numeric stats (ATK, HP, etc.) use monospaced-style alignment
visual: Character avatars sit on subtle glowing platform/halo
Navigation icons are circular with soft inner shadow
Action buttons use rounded rectangle with 1px subtle border
Background maintains atmospheric depth with faint vignette
